name: Alex Morgan
biography:
I’m an independent product designer turning complex ideas into thoughtful, approachable digital experiences.

My practice connects **research, interaction design, and clear visual systems**. I work with ambitious teams to make everyday tools more useful, welcoming, and human.

education.description: Focused on human-centered design, visual communication, and accessible interfaces. My final project explored digital tools for stronger local communities.

jobs.description: Partnering with early-stage teams on research, product strategy, and thoughtful web and mobile experiences.
Designed and shipped accessible interfaces across education, community, and climate projects. Built reusable design systems and mentored junior designers.
